# ForeverUnitFrames

Clean, flat **player and target frames** for World of Warcraft with buffs, debuffs, portraits and profiles – every frame configured on its own, with a live preview in the settings.

![Features](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/main/Images/features_en.png)

## Features

- **Separate player, target and target-of-target frames** – own scale, bar sizes, colors, texture and portrait for each
- **Health bars** – class color, by health or custom color; four text modes; built-in textures plus everything from [LibSharedMedia](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libsharedmedia-3-0)
- **Portraits** in six shapes (round, rounded, square, diamond, hexagon, octagon) with adjustable size and position
- **Buffs & debuffs** – filters (own, short, dispellable/stealable), adjustable icon size and count, highlighting of dispellable enemy buffs
- **Dragon ornament** – Elite, Rare Elite or Boss; matches the target automatically
- **Profiles** – any number of profiles, one per character, copy settings between them
- **Edit Mode support** – move the frames with Blizzard's Edit Mode
- Optionally hides Blizzard's player/target frames and buff/debuff bars

![Portrait shapes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/main/Images/portraits_en.png)

![Bar styles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/main/Images/bars_en.png)

## Installation

1. Download the latest release zip (or the CurseForge file).
2. Extract it into `World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\`, so the folder structure is:
   ```
   Interface\AddOns\ForeverUnitFrames\ForeverUnitFrames.toc
   ```
3. Restart the game or type `/reload`.

To install from source, clone the repository into a folder named exactly `ForeverUnitFrames` – WoW only loads the addon if the folder name matches the `.toc` file.

## Usage

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/ff` | Open the settings |
| `/ff unlock` | Open Edit Mode to move the frames |
| `/foreverframes` | Same as `/ff` |

Settings are also available under **Options → AddOns → ForeverUnitFrames**.

**Notes**
- The settings UI is currently in **German** only.
- Showing Blizzard's frames again only takes effect after `/reload`.
- Cancelling buffs with a right-click only works through Blizzard's buff bar.

## Project Structure

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ForeverUnitFrames.toc` | Addon metadata and load order |
| `Core.lua` | Saved variables, profiles, events, slash commands |
| `Auras.lua` | Buff and debuff handling |
| `Frames.lua` | Player and target frames, bars, portraits, ornaments |
| `Options.lua` | Settings panels with live preview |
| `Media/` | Logo and portrait masks (`.tga`) |
| `Images/` | Promo images for the README and CurseForge (not part of the addon) |

Settings are stored in the saved variable `ForeverUnitFramesDB`.

## [v0.8.0](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/tree/v0.8.0) (2026-11-25)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/releases)

- Add 5-second rule and mana tick spark on the player mana bar  
    After spending mana a spark runs across the mana bar for 5 seconds,  
    then follows the 2-second mana tick rhythm. Works with secret mana  
    values by detecting spends via spell costs and ticks via power events.  
    Toggleable in the player options; not created on retail clients.

## [v0.7.1](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/tree/v0.7.1) (2026-11-25)

- Fix boxes in names with non-Latin characters  
    SetFont with a single font file has no glyph fallback, so Cyrillic,  
    Korean or Chinese names showed as boxes. Use font families covering  
    all alphabets, like Blizzard's own frames.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

# ForeverUnitFrames

## [v0.7.0](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/tree/v0.7.0) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/releases)

- Add target of target frame and per-bar size settings  
    - New target of target frame with its own options page and the same  
      settings and behavior as player and target; smaller base size, portrait  
      on the left like the player frame  
    - Target of target polls health, power and auras, since the client sends  
      no unit events for "targettarget"  
    - Width and height per bar (health and power) as percent added to the  
      scale (1.2 and -20% = 1.0), optionally keeping proportions  
    - Each bar gets its own background and border, so bars of different  
      widths form a stepped shape instead of leaving a gap  
    - Frames snap to all other frames, including top and bottom edges  
    - Existing profiles keep their look (all bar sizes default to 0%)  
    - English and German texts for all new options  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

## [v0.5.1](https://github.com/T3rr0rS0ck3/ForeverUnitFrames/tree/v0.5.1) (2026-11-15)

- Show auras via Blizzard AuraContainer; fix secret value errors  
    - Buffs and debuffs are displayed through Blizzard's AuraContainer, so they  
      work in combat and on friendly targets where addon aura reads are blocked  
    - Reset the containers on target change so the previous target's auras

    - Own aura icons remain as fallback and options preview
